project_summary: General-purpose norns/grid development utility using pinned official monome runtime sources. C16 adds an explicitly selected experimental native controlled-clock candidate. The verified real-time installation is unchanged. Mosaic is an external acceptance project, not a core dependency. This is the bounded Codex-only P5 clock-adapter review, not full emulator or Mosaic release approval.
diff_intent: Review C16 changes from ce812e7: native scheduler/internal-clock/metro stepping seams, logical clock and event draining, early Lua time binding, MIDI emission timestamps and injected MIDI clock, Python Session opt-in/advance API, generic native probes and external Mosaic diagnostics. Read PLAN.md C16, ACCEPTANCE.md D/M5, UPSTREAM.md and docs/architecture/controlled-time-investigation.md plus C16 completion/progress notes. Local candidate paths and external Mosaic evidence are supplied in the explicit context file. M5 release-check currently fails closed as unimplemented; P5 completion and the admission gate must both exist before D is admitted. Earlier successful milestones and future full workflow/Linux release obligations are not re-certified here.
focus: Find consequential reproducible clock-fidelity or false-green defects: missed time sources, pulse/reference interpolation and tempo/reset/source changes, callback/deadline ordering, cancellation and runaway bounds, early/late acknowledgements, source/build identity, independent musical oracles, repeat normalization and separation from real-time acceptance. Challenge the known opening-note discrepancy using native contracts; do not turn existing app/dependency defects into runtime workarounds. Inspect candidate build preservation of the default installation and generic/app separation. Report the unimplemented admission gate as an outstanding requirement, never infer admission from experimental passing tests. Keep one-shot review proportionate; no dual-vendor convergence, whole-repo mutation campaign or manual/hardware certification. Cite files and evidence for substantive findings. One focused follow-up remains available after fixes and gate implementation.
